items.title: Gate releases on collector and phone behavior checks

handoff.outcome: CI test job (Python 3.11, Node 24, watch tools required) now gates release-please and publish; percentage matrix 0/0.5/1/2/100/missing covers Codex fake app-server and both Claude payloads; build-environment test repaired after issue 33. Not yet run on a GitHub runner: the branch was not pushed.
handoff.next_actor: Antti Kaihola (acceptance review; first GitHub run after the next push to main)

checks.command: nix-shell -p python311 --run 'python3 --version && PEBBLE_QUOTA_REQUIRE_WATCH_TOOLS=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests'

uv run --no-project --with pyyaml python -c "import yaml; j=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/build.yml'))['jobs']; assert set(j['release-please']['needs'])=={'test','build'}, j['release-please']['needs']; assert set(j['publish']['needs'])=={'test','build','release-please'}; assert not any(f in str(j[n].get('if','')) for n in ('release-please','publish') for f in ('always()','failure()','cancelled()')); assert 'unittest discover' in str(j['test']['steps']) and j['test']['env']['PEBBLE_QUOTA_REQUIRE_WATCH_TOOLS']=='1'"

tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && git archive 409ab31dcc23c70eec2863a1b9d2ea2d156760f1 | tar -x -C "$tmp" && sed -i 's/(1, .01, 1, 49)/(1, 1.0, 1, 49)/' "$tmp/tests/test_pebble_quota.py" && grep -q '(1, 1.0, 1, 49)' "$tmp/tests/test_pebble_quota.py" && ! (cd "$tmp" && python3 -m unittest tests.test_pebble_quota.ClaudeCollectTests tests.test_pebble_quota.CodexRPCTests)
